scope: Independent narrow technical static review and byte-exact additive composition proof for the three HEX models rebased onto accepted Stage28 VREF; excludes hardware qualification, runtime behavior, firmware, full builds and legal clearance.
checks: Independently read Stage27, Stage28 and accepted HEX ZIP bytes, recomputed diffs and hashes; did not rely on implementation proof Boolean conclusions.
All three before/after snapshots match the archived Stage28 and candidate model bytes; all six frozen snapshots have mode 0444.
Removing the independently derived HEX insertions reconstructs accepted Stage28 byte for byte; removing independently derived VREF insertions reconstructs accepted Stage27 HEX byte for byte.
Removing both additions in either order reconstructs the identical Stage27 baseline; only HEX insertion counts 14/14/13 and unchanged VREF insertion counts 11/11/9 occur.
The 981-entry initial candidate-source-manifest matched all candidate file bytes at review time. This is a snapshot result, not a claim about later non-model acceptance edits.

The authored additive evidence was read and verified against independently accepted insertion text and model hashes; all current candidate model hashes rechecked before this receipt was written.

compatibility.optional_fields: HEX and reference_divider retain Option fields. Serde missing/null values yield None and None is omitted during serialization. Generator models retain default None and static models retain corresponding Option types.
compatibility.required_nested_fields: Present HEX requires all six nested fields and its input requires all four ExternalClockLimits fields. Present VREF requires its five fields. No default synthesizes electrical facts.
compatibility.types: All three model projections retain reviewed field widths, signedness and fixed tuple shapes; VREF static strings/slices and custom generator Debug field remain unchanged.
compatibility.source_compatibility: Backward-compatible JSON is not Rust struct literal source compatibility: consumers constructing these public structs directly must provide the added fields.
compatibility.validation_boundary: Schemas constrain structure and numeric representation, not physical admissibility, interval ordering, percentages, source qualification or HSE/HEX mutual exclusion.

lineage_preconditions: Install this actual independent review as docs/hex-stage28-schema-review.json and the verified additive evidence as docs/hex-stage28-schema-additions.json.
Advance serde replacement_review tip to the exact accepted combined hash and references only after acceptance; set independent_review_passed=true and move pending_extension into accepted_extensions.

Nest the complete current VREF replacement_review as previous_review and preserve all historical accepted_extensions, original predecessor identities, project-authored replacement status, exclusions and unresolved permission findings.
Retain the independently accepted standalone HEX review with its original Stage27 scope; record both metapac identities without changing adapted-source ancestry or historical observed hashes.
Keep legal_clearance=false. Regenerate/relock affected provenance inventories and pass distribution verification after acceptance edits before packaging.
